{
  "candidate_rtl": "module alu_64bit(
    input [63:0] a, b,
    input [2:0] Oper,
    output reg [63:0] sum
);
    wire [63:0] x;
    wire [63:0] ca, cs, cr;
    wire [63:0] add_result, sub_result, reverse_result;

    assign x = a ^ b;

    alu64_carry_tree u_add (
        .p(x), .g(a & b), .cin(1'b0), .c(ca)
    );
    alu64_carry_tree u_sub (
        .p(~x), .g(a & ~b), .cin(1'b1), .c(cs)
    );
    alu64_carry_tree u_reverse (
        .p(~x), .g(~a & b), .cin(1'b1), .c(cr)
    );

    assign add_result = x ^ ca;
    assign sub_result = (~x) ^ cs;
    assign reverse_result = (~x) ^ cr;

    always @(*) begin
        case (Oper)
            3'b000: sum = add_result;
            3'b001: sum = sub_result;
            3'b010: sum = reverse_result;
            3'b011: sum = a | b;
            3'b100: sum = a & b;
            3'b101: sum = x;
            3'b110: sum = ~x;
            default: sum = 64'b0;
        endcase
    end
endmodule

module alu64_carry_tree(
    input [63:0] p,
    input [63:0] g,
    input cin,
    output [63:0] c
);
    wire [15:0] gp, gg;
    wire [3:0] sp, sg;
    wire [3:0] sc;
    wire [15:0] gc;

    genvar n;
    generate
        for (n = 0; n < 16; n = n + 1) begin : nibble_summary
            assign gp[n] = &p[4*n+3:4*n];
            assign gg[n] = g[4*n+3]
                         | (p[4*n+3] & g[4*n+2])
                         | (p[4*n+3] & p[4*n+2] & g[4*n+1])
                         | (p[4*n+3] & p[4*n+2] & p[4*n+1] & g[4*n]);
        end
        for (n = 0; n < 4; n = n + 1) begin : super_summary
            assign sp[n] = &gp[4*n+3:4*n];
            assign sg[n] = gg[4*n+3]
                         | (gp[4*n+3] & gg[4*n+2])
                         | (gp[4*n+3] & gp[4*n+2] & gg[4*n+1])
                         | (gp[4*n+3] & gp[4*n+2] & gp[4*n+1] & gg[4*n]);
        end
    endgenerate

    assign sc[0] = cin;
    assign sc[1] = sg[0] | (sp[0] & cin);
    assign sc[2] = sg[1]
                 | (sp[1] & sg[0])
                 | (sp[1] & sp[0] & cin);
    assign sc[3] = sg[2]
                 | (sp[2] & sg[1])
                 | (sp[2] & sp[1] & sg[0])
                 | (sp[2] & sp[1] & sp[0] & cin);

    generate
        for (n = 0; n < 4; n = n + 1) begin : group_carries
            assign gc[4*n] = sc[n];
            assign gc[4*n+1] = gg[4*n]
                              | (gp[4*n] & sc[n]);
            assign gc[4*n+2] = gg[4*n+1]
                              | (gp[4*n+1] & gg[4*n])
                              | (gp[4*n+1] & gp[4*n] & sc[n]);
            assign gc[4*n+3] = gg[4*n+2]
                              | (gp[4*n+2] & gg[4*n+1])
                              | (gp[4*n+2] & gp[4*n+1] & gg[4*n])
                              | (gp[4*n+2] & gp[4*n+1] & gp[4*n] & sc[n]);
        end
        for (n = 0; n < 16; n = n + 1) begin : bit_carries
            assign c[4*n] = gc[n];
            assign c[4*n+1] = g[4*n]
                             | (p[4*n] & gc[n]);
            assign c[4*n+2] = g[4*n+1]
                             | (p[4*n+1] & g[4*n])
                             | (p[4*n+1] & p[4*n] & gc[n]);
            assign c[4*n+3] = g[4*n+2]
                             | (p[4*n+2] & g[4*n+1])
                             | (p[4*n+2] & p[4*n+1] & g[4*n])
                             | (p[4*n+2] & p[4*n+1] & p[4*n] & gc[n]);
        end
    endgenerate
endmodule
",
  "bottleneck": "The reported paths traverse long arithmetic carry logic before the final sum XOR and operation selection. Upper-bit arithmetic results, rather than the bitwise operations, are the primary timing target.",
  "rewrite": "Use three parallel, explicitly structured radix-4 hierarchical carry-lookahead networks for addition and both subtraction directions. Four-bit summaries feed sixteen-bit summaries, with lookahead at each boundary and explicit local carry equations. Share the operand XOR between arithmetic propagate generation and logical results. Keep operation selection after the parallel datapaths, avoiding an operation-controlled operand mux ahead of carry generation.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "The bounded carry hierarchy is intended to reduce the baseline 3.05 ns maximum arrival by shortening long carry dependencies. A numerical improvement is not established: the supplied mapping and STA flow must measure this candidate, since ABC restructuring, buffering, and shared-net fanout affect the result.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Three parallel arithmetic carry networks trade hardware for timing and avoid serial operand selection. Shared XOR logic and pruning of unused carry-out summaries limit overhead. Mapped area, compliance with the 13098.437440 um^2 cap, and zero electrical violations require validation; no candidate implementation results are available.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Preserves the original module interface, unsigned 64-bit operands, 3-bit operation selector, and combinational 64-bit output. Arithmetic results are modulo 2^64: a+b, a-b, and b-a for operations 000, 001, and 010. Operations 011 through 110 retain OR, AND, XOR, and XNOR; 111 retains the zero default. The original internal c_out has no observable use and is omitted. No parameters, clocks, storage, latency, assumptions, or external dependencies are introduced. Formal mapped equivalence remains to be checked."
}
